shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && sed -n '1,280p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool-example.test.ts && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool-example.test.ts && git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff -- .lore/dod.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md README.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --no-index /dev/null src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool-example.test.ts || true'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md .specify/spec.md CHANGELOG.md README.md adrs/ADR-002-response-validation.md docs/adding-a-tool.md example/weather-tool.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/weather-tool-example.test.ts && git commit -m "Document tool input validation contract" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
